src/agent_runtime/auth/init.py

Python · Tier A

Export shared Auth requirements, safe errors and broker entry points.

Responsibilities

Export shared Auth requirements, safe errors and broker entry points.

Boundaries

Concrete lifecycle and execution behavior belong to the imported modules.

Lifecycle

Registry/bootstrap imports this package before invoking its exported API.

State

Exports add no datastore, transport, timer or credential cache.

Security

Importing a factory or contract grants no authority and performs no network I/O.

Collaborators

src/agent_runtime/auth/broker.py supplies implementation.

Public surface

AuthBroker, broker_for, AuthRequirement, CredentialLease and safe exceptions.

@see src/agent_runtime/auth/broker.py

src/agent_runtime/auth/broker.py

Python · Tier A

Coordinate shared OAuth authorization, refresh and revision-bound credential leases.

Responsibilities

Coordinate shared OAuth authorization, refresh and revision-bound credential leases.

Boundaries

Consumers own resource protocols; Parameter Store alone owns durable credentials.

Lifecycle

ensure reuses, refreshes or suspends; callback consumes state before exchange and atomic save.

State

Fixed refresh locks, capped clients/transactions and expiry timers are process-local.

Security

Bind leases and interaction errors to exact consumer, operation, run, profile revisions and Gateway. Never return protocol secrets in public evidence.

Collaborators

auth/oauth2.py validates provider protocols; native/http_session_state.py suspends exact invocations.

Public surface

broker_for, utcnow, remaining, owner, AuthBroker.

@see src/agent_runtime/auth/broker.py

Own bounded browser authorization, PKCE state and callback listeners.

Responsibilities

Own bounded browser authorization, PKCE state and callback listeners.

Boundaries

Adapters choose scopes, verify provider identity and persist tokens.

Lifecycle

Prepare a request, publish an opaque launch ticket, then consume callback state once.

State

One RLock and expiry timer own at most 32 ten-minute handshakes; desktop listeners exit when state disappears.

Security

Collaborators

Public surface
